note: Rate every statement 1-5. The pre-score is taken at the beginning (before the Letter from Christ); the post-score at the end, after the last module. The total score is the sum of all ratings.

statements.text: I spend time in prayer and reflection each day.
I read and meditate on God's Word regularly.
I trust God's plan even when circumstances are hard.
I give thanks in all circumstances.
I tell the truth even when it costs me.
I keep my promises and commitments.
I take responsibility for my mistakes.
I choose what is right over what is easy.
I treat others with kindness and respect.
I forgive those who wrong me.
I listen patiently before responding.
I look for ways to serve the people around me.
I set goals and work steadily toward them.
I manage my time and avoid what harms me.
I stay committed even when I feel like quitting.
I use my gifts and talents to their full extent.
I stand for my beliefs even under pressure.
I speak about my faith with confidence.
I face my fears instead of avoiding them.
I encourage others to do what is right.
